objects.description: During the [2026 Iranian Water Campaign](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0065), [CyberAv3ngers](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1027) were observed using secure shell ports TCP/22 and common industrial ports (TCP/44818, TCP&UDP/2222, TCP/102, and TCP/502).
